tools.name: getV2Health
tools.description:
GET /v2/health
Returns the Platform v2 API process status.

tools.name: getV2OperationalStatus
tools.description:
GET /v2/status
Returns health information for Platform data, caches, media, webhooks, and Steam automation.

tools.name: listV2Capabilities
tools.description:
GET /v2/meta/capabilities
Lists each Platform feature as production, unavailable, or planned, together with the API-key scopes it requires.

tools.name: listV2Scopes
tools.description:
GET /v2/meta/scopes
Returns every recognized scope in stable documentation order.

tools.name: getV2Principal
tools.description:
GET /v2/me
Authenticates the API key and returns its workspace, service tier, and granted scopes.

tools.name: getV2Usage
tools.description:
GET /v2/usage
Returns the workspace-wide minute and UTC-day weighted unit budget shared by every key in the subscribed workspace. Per-operation request/unit/error counters remain attributed to the current API key. Calling this endpoint consumes one unit.

tools.name: listV2AuditEvents
tools.description:
GET /v2/audit/events
Returns the workspace’s audit events in newest-first order, including Platform settings and Steam automation events. Secret fields are removed from nested metadata. Each event can store up to 32 KiB of metadata.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page. Pass it back unchanged and with the same filters; otherwise the API returns 400.

tools.name: listV2AuditExports
tools.description:
GET /v2/audit/exports
Returns audit export jobs in newest-first order.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page. Pass it back unchanged and with the same state filter.

tools.name: createV2AuditExport
tools.description:
POST /v2/audit/exports
Queues a verified export of audit events in the requested time range. The range must be in the past, use an inclusive start and exclusive end, and span no more than 32 days.

to.description: Exclusive UTC range end. Must be in the past and no more than 32 days after from.

tools.name: getV2AuditExport
tools.description:
GET /v2/audit/exports/{export_id}
Returns one audit export job. A completed, unexpired export includes a new short-lived HTTPS download URL.

tools.name: listV2CatalogItems
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/items
Returns Steam Market item variants that use the cs2.market.v1 identity format. Treat catalog IDs and cursors as API-generated values and pass them back unchanged.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page. Omit it for the first page.

tools.name: getV2CatalogItem
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/items/{catalog_id}
Returns the catalog item identified by a versioned catalog ID.

tools.name: listV2CatalogCollections
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/collections
Returns CS2 collections and the source of each collection record. Current collection membership data comes from ByMykel CSGO-API.

tools.name: getV2CatalogCollection
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/collections/{collection_id}
Returns one collection and its Steam Market item variants.

tools.name: listV2CatalogContainers
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/containers
Returns CS2 containers and the number of imported regular and rare drops for each container.

tools.name: getV2CatalogContainerContents
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/containers/{catalog_id}/contents
Returns the regular and rare item drops recorded for one container.

tools.name: listV2CatalogCurrencies
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/currencies
Rates are expressed as units of the named currency per one USD and retain the Frankfurter observation timestamp.

tools.name: getV2CatalogSnapshot
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/snapshot
Returns a SHA-256 digest and ETag for the current catalog state. The result represents one database transaction and is cached for five minutes.

tools.name: getLatestV2CatalogRelease
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/releases/latest
Returns the latest release only after verifying its Ed25519 signature with the configured trusted key. A published release cannot be changed.

tools.name: getV2CatalogRelease
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/releases/{release_id}
Returns the requested catalog release after verifying its signature.

tools.name: getV2CatalogReleaseExport
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/releases/{release_id}/export
Returns a five-minute download URL for the signed release’s gzip-compressed NDJSON archive.

tools.name: listV2CatalogReleaseKeys
tools.description:
GET /v2/catalog/release-keys
Lists the public keys trusted to verify catalog releases.

tools.name: getV2CurrentPrices
tools.description:
GET /v2/prices/{catalog_id}
Returns current prices for one catalog item as decimal strings, including source time and freshness. A version filter selects one stored version; an unfiltered request returns every stored version.

version.description: Exact source pattern, phase, or tier. Omit to return all stored versions.

tools.name: getV2CurrentOrderBook
tools.description:
GET /v2/prices/{catalog_id}/orderbook
Returns exact decimal bid, ask, spread, active order counts, stored depth, slippage, liquidity, source time, and freshness. The order book is Steam-only and is not inferred from third-party listings.

tools.name: getV2OrderBookHistory
tools.description:
GET /v2/prices/{catalog_id}/orderbook/history
Returns historical Steam order-book data for one catalog item. Each point includes the best bid and ask, spread, buy and sell order counts, price depth, slippage, and observation time. Use `from` and `to` to limit the time range.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page. Pass it back unchanged with the same `catalog_id`, `from`, and `to` values.

tools.name: getV2CurrentPricesBatch
tools.description:
POST /v2/prices/batch
Returns prices for up to 100 catalog items in request order. Items with a valid ID but no stored price are reported separately.

tools.name: getV2PriceHistory
tools.description:
GET /v2/prices/{catalog_id}/history
Returns stored daily, hourly, or 10-minute source prices as decimal strings. Pass a cursor back only with the same filters.

version.description: Exact pattern or phase. Omit to return each stored version as a separate point.

tools.name: getV2AggregatePriceHistory
tools.description:
GET /v2/prices/{catalog_id}/history/aggregate
Returns decimal price aggregates for each item version and identifies every marketplace and source price included in each aggregate.

version.description: Exact pattern or phase. Omit to return each version as a separate aggregate point.

tools.name: getV2PriceHistoryCoverage
tools.description:
GET /v2/prices/{catalog_id}/history/coverage
Reports the stored time range and the number of present, expected, and missing buckets for each marketplace, version, and interval. It also returns a SHA-256 receipt for the page.

version.description: Exact pattern or phase; an explicit empty value selects only the unversioned series.

cursor.description: Filter-bound keyset cursor over marketplace, version, and granularity.

tools.name: listV2Markets
tools.description:
GET /v2/markets
Lists supported marketplaces and the age at which each source is considered stale.

tools.name: getV2MarketSummary
tools.description:
GET /v2/market/summary
Returns current USD totals calculated from the latest source prices. This is a point-in-time summary, not a historical price index.

value.description: Exact segment value; required with segment.

tools.name: listV2MarketSegments
tools.description:
GET /v2/market/segments
Lists the CS2 item segments that currently have enough price data for market-index calculations.

tools.name: getV2CS2MarketIndex
tools.description:
GET /v2/market-index/cs2
Returns the latest successful cs2.chain-equal-weight.v1 index calculation for one marketplace and, optionally, one segment. The response includes the latest point and the data needed to reproduce the calculation.

value.description: Exact segment value; required with segment.

tools.name: getV2CS2MarketIndexCoverage
tools.description:
GET /v2/market-index/cs2/coverage
Reports the stored and missing daily buckets for the latest completed index calculation. Missing ranges include both boundary dates.

value.description: Exact segment value; required with segment.

tools.name: getV2CS2MarketIndexHistory
tools.description:
GET /v2/market-index/cs2/history
Returns daily, weekly, or monthly candles from the latest completed index calculation, ordered newest first.

value.description: Exact segment value; required with segment.

tools.name: compareV2CS2MarketIndices
tools.description:
GET /v2/market-index/cs2/compare
Compares two to eight separately calculated segment indices. The response preserves request order. If any requested series is missing, the endpoint returns an error instead of a partial comparison.

value.description: Repeat this parameter two to eight times; request order becomes response-series order.

tools.name: getV2Inventory
tools.description:
GET /v2/inventories/{steam_id}
Returns any public Steam inventory with one record per asset and exact Valve-provided item state when available. Ordinary reads return the first saved public observation at any age and avoid a Steam request. An explicit max_age_seconds may fetch a newer observation while retaining the saved copy. A successful force_refresh request replaces it; a private response invalidates it. A Platform API key authenticates the API caller, and a publicly visible Steam inventory is the owner's sole requirement.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum observation age before attempting Steam. If omitted, use the saved observation at any age. Cannot accompany force_refresh=true.

force_refresh.description: Attempt Steam even when a cached observation qualifies; a successful public response replaces the saved durable observation. Default false.

stale_if_error_seconds.description: Maximum observation age allowed only after a Steam failure or rate limit; default 1800.

tools.name: fetchV2InventoryWithRequestProxy
tools.description:
POST /v2/inventories/{steam_id}/fetch
Reads an acceptable shared public snapshot when available; otherwise fetches the public Steam inventory only through the HTTP(S) proxy supplied in this request. Proxy configuration and credentials remain request-scoped, and proxy failures return a sanitized upstream error with platform and direct fallback disabled.

freshness.description: One policy for every batch entry. Only a successful force_refresh replaces an existing saved observation. Explicit max_age_seconds cannot accompany force_refresh=true.

tools.name: getV2InventoryBatch
tools.description:
POST /v2/inventories/batch
Results preserve input order and report failures per SteamID. An optional freshness object applies one policy to the whole batch; omitted fields use scalar defaults.

freshness.description: One policy for every batch entry. Only a successful force_refresh replaces an existing saved observation. Explicit max_age_seconds cannot accompany force_refresh=true.

tools.name: decodeV2Inspect
tools.description:
POST /v2/inspect/decode
Reads a current CS2 inspect link and returns its wear, paint seed, stickers, charm, StatTrak value, and name tag.

tools.name: resolveV2InspectItem
tools.description:
POST /v2/inspect/resolve-item
Reads a current CS2 inspect link, identifies its catalog item, and returns the details needed to create an image or 3D view.

link.description: Current self-encoded steam:// CS2 inspect link or certificate payload accepted by the inspect decoder.

tools.name: createV2InspectViewerSession
tools.description:
POST /v2/inspect/viewer-session
Reads a current CS2 inspect link and creates a temporary 3D link using saved camera and background settings.

link.description: Current self-encoded steam:// CS2 inspect link or certificate payload accepted by the inspect decoder.

tools.name: createV2InspectImageRender
tools.description:
POST /v2/inspect/render
Requires inspect:read, catalog:read, and render:create. Reads a current inspect link and creates a transparent PNG or WebP that keeps its StatTrak value, name tag, stickers, charm, wear, and pattern.

link.description: Current self-encoded steam:// CS2 inspect link or certificate payload accepted by the inspect decoder.

background.description: Returns an alpha-bearing item cutout. The pinned scene supplies camera and lighting inputs, but its visible background is not included.

tools.name: createV2InspectLink
tools.description:
POST /v2/inspect/create-link
Creates a current CS2 inspect link from the supplied item data.

tools.name: resolveV2MarketListingInspect
tools.description:
POST /v2/inspect/resolve-market-listing
Fetches the listing from Steam Community Market, verifies that its listing ID matches the request, and decodes Valve asset property 6 into the public item format. The request accepts a listing ID, not an arbitrary URL or inspect certificate.

tools.name: normalizeV2SteamID
tools.description:
GET /v2/steam/ids/{steam_id}
Converts a public individual SteamID64, SteamID2, or SteamID3 to the other supported formats.

steam_id.description: Public individual SteamID64, SteamID2, or SteamID3

tools.name: resolveV2SteamIdentity
tools.description:
GET /v2/steam/resolve/{identity}
Normalizes SteamID64, SteamID2, and SteamID3 locally. Vanity names are resolved through Valve's documented ResolveVanityURL endpoint and include source, observation, and cache metadata.

identity.description: Public individual SteamID64, SteamID2, SteamID3, or Steam Community vanity name

tools.name: getV2SteamProfile
tools.description:
GET /v2/profiles/{steam_id}
Returns a normalized public profile with explicit source and cache freshness.

steam_id.description: Public individual SteamID64, SteamID2, or SteamID3

tools.name: getV2SteamProfileBatch
tools.description:
POST /v2/profiles/batch
Preserves request order, coalesces duplicate IDs, and reports missing profiles per entry.

tools.name: getV2SteamFriends
tools.description:
GET /v2/profiles/{steam_id}/friends
Returns the current public friend list for one Steam profile.

steam_id.description: Public individual SteamID64, SteamID2, or SteamID3

tools.name: getV2SteamTradeEligibility
tools.description:
GET /v2/profiles/{steam_id}/trade-eligibility
Reports public ban/economy signals only. complete is always false because private holds and partner-specific restrictions require an authenticated account check.

steam_id.description: Public individual SteamID64, SteamID2, or SteamID3

tools.name: listV2SteamAccounts
tools.description:
GET /v2/steam/accounts
Returns the connected Steam accounts owned by the current workspace.

tools.name: createV2SteamAccount
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts
Creates a Steam account record for the current workspace.

tools.name: getV2SteamAccountHealth
tools.description:
GET /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/health
Returns the account’s session, authenticator, inventory, reconciliation, command, and trading status.

tools.name: updateV2SteamAccountControls
tools.description:
PUT /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/controls
Pauses or resumes Steam account changes. Pausing cancels queued state-changing commands and disables the active trade policy.

tools.name: loginV2SteamAccount
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/login
Authenticates a connected Steam account with a username and password or a Steam refresh token. Successful authentication saves a refresh token for later sessions.

tools.name: importV2SteamWebAPIKey
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/web-api-key
Stores the connected account’s IEconService key in encrypted workspace storage.

web_api_key.description: The managed account's own Steam Web API key. It is encrypted immediately and never returned.

tools.name: refreshV2SteamSession
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/refresh-session
Uses the encrypted refresh token inside the isolated worker and rotates only the encrypted short-lived session cookie. No token is returned in command data.

tools.name: fetchV2SteamPartnerInventory
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/partner-inventory/fetch
Queues a private read of the trade-eligible CS2 assets Steam exposes to one connected viewer account. The optional partner token and proxy credentials are encrypted immediately. A supplied proxy handles every page and retry; the request fails rather than switching to another egress path. The result represents trade-eligible coverage; trade creation and complete owner coverage remain separate operations.

trade_offer_token.description: Optional token from the target's Steam trade URL. Encrypted immediately and never returned.

proxy.description: Optional request-scoped HTTP(S) proxy used for every page and retry. Supply username and password together. Credentials are encrypted immediately and excluded from results and errors. A proxy failure terminates the request rather than switching egress paths.

tools.name: getV2SteamPartnerInventory
tools.description:
GET /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/partner-inventory/{command_id}
Returns the tenant-private trade-eligible observation produced by one completed partner-inventory command. Public inventory caching remains isolated to public observations.

tools.name: syncV2AuthenticatedSteamInventory
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/inventory/sync
Queues a private CS2 inventory sync through Steam’s Econ service and returns the command status.

tools.name: getV2AuthenticatedSteamInventory
tools.description:
GET /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/inventory
Returns the latest saved inventory for the connected account with catalog, price, valuation, and inspect-link fields.

tools.name: listV2AuthenticatedSteamInventoryHistory
tools.description:
GET /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/inventory/history
Returns saved inventory snapshots and the exact assets added, removed, or changed between snapshots for a Steam account owned by the current workspace. It omits historical valuations because applying current prices to older inventories would be misleading. Requires accounts:read and inventory:read.

tools.name: generateV2SteamGuardCode
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/guard/code
Generates a Steam Guard code and encrypts it for the caller’s P-256 public key.

delivery_public_key.description: Base64 DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo for a caller-owned P-256 ECDH key

tools.name: fetchV2SteamTradeLink
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/trade-link
Returns the account’s current Steam trade URL encrypted for the caller’s P-256 public key.

delivery_public_key.description: Base64 DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo for a caller-owned P-256 ECDH key

tools.name: importV2SteamAuthenticator
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/authenticator/import
Imports and stores the account’s Steam authenticator values as one encrypted set.

shared_secret.description: Decoded Steam shared secret, base64-encoded for transport

identity_secret.description: Decoded Steam identity secret, base64-encoded for transport

revocation_code.description: UTF-8 revocation code bytes, base64-encoded for transport

device_id.description: UTF-8 android device identifier bytes, base64-encoded for transport

tools.name: enrollV2SteamAuthenticator
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/authenticator/enroll
Stores the provisional authenticator data in encrypted storage for 24 hours. The data becomes active account credentials only after Steam accepts the finalization request.

tools.name: finalizeV2SteamAuthenticator
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/authenticator/enroll/{enrollment_id}/finalize
The one-time activation code is encrypted before queuing. Authenticator secrets become active account credentials only after Steam confirms finalization.

tools.name: removeV2SteamAuthenticator
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/authenticator/remove
OpenSkin destroys its active shared, identity, revocation, and device envelopes only after Steam confirms removal. Cookie revocation is an explicit caller choice.

tools.name: startV2SteamAuthenticatorRecovery
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/authenticator/recovery
Requests an SMS challenge through Steam’s authenticator recovery protocol.

tools.name: completeV2SteamAuthenticatorRecovery
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/authenticator/recovery/{recovery_id}/complete
Completes Steam authenticator recovery with the SMS code and stores the replacement authenticator values.

tools.name: listV2SteamCommands
tools.description:
GET /v2/steam/commands
Returns Steam command history for the current workspace in newest-first order.

tools.name: getV2SteamCommand
tools.description:
GET /v2/steam/commands/{command_id}
Returns sanitized command state. Sensitive results, such as Steam Guard codes, are returned only as ciphertext encrypted for the caller.

tools.name: listV2SteamConfirmations
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/guard/confirmations
Queues retrieval of the account’s current mobile confirmations. Stored confirmation secrets remain encrypted.

tools.name: resolveV2SteamConfirmation
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/guard/confirmations/{confirmation_id}
Queues acceptance or denial of one confirmation. Immediately before acting, OpenSkin fetches the current confirmations again and continues only if exactly one entry matches the confirmation ID, nonce, and creator ID. The confirmation signature is generated from encrypted account secrets.

creator_id.description: Steam creator ID returned by the current confirmation-list operation. OpenSkin checks it with the confirmation ID and nonce immediately before acting.

tools.name: resolveV2SteamConfirmationBatch
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/guard/confirmations/batch
Queues one accept or deny decision for 1 to 10 explicitly selected confirmations. Each confirmation ID may appear once. OpenSkin re-reads the current list and acts only when every confirmation ID, nonce, and creator ID still matches. Unlisted confirmations remain unchanged; there is no confirm-all operation.

confirmations.description: One to 10 confirmation evidence records returned by the current list operation. Each confirmation ID may appear once.

tools.name: disconnectV2SteamAccount
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/disconnect
Queues removal of the Steam account connection. After Steam confirms the operation, OpenSkin deletes the stored credentials.

tools.name: checkV2SteamTradeHold
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/trade-hold-check
Returns the current combined Steam trade-hold duration between the connected account and one partner.

trade_offer_token.description: Optional token from the partner trade URL; encrypted before the command is stored

tools.name: getV2SteamTradePolicy
tools.description:
GET /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/trade-policy
Returns a disabled fail-closed policy when no policy has been configured.

tools.name: updateV2SteamTradePolicy
tools.description:
PUT /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/trade-policy
Enables or disables trade execution and sets partner, gift, and asset-count limits. The request is rejected while account changes are paused.

max_offered_value_usd.description: Server-enforced ceiling for the total OpenSkin-valued USD amount leaving the account. Must be greater than zero when enabled.

max_daily_trade_count.description: Maximum newly authorized trade operations in any rolling 24-hour window.

max_daily_offered_value_usd.description: Maximum server-valued outgoing USD amount authorized in any rolling 24-hour window. Must be at least max_offered_value_usd.

tools.name: syncV2SteamTrades
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/trades/sync
Reads sent and incoming Steam trade offers and saves their direction, items, hold status, protection status, current state, and reversals.

tools.name: syncV2SteamTradeHistory
tools.description:
POST /v2/steam/accounts/{account_id}/trades/history/sync
Imports up to 100 Steam trade-history entries and matches them by trade ID, partner, and items. Use the cursor from the completed account action to request the next page.

cursor.description: Opaque account-bound cursor returned by the previous history-sync command. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: previewV2TradeIntent
tools.description:
POST /v2/trade-intents/preview
Validates an outbound create_offer instruction or a synchronized incoming accept_offer instruction against the current account and trade policy.

target_trade_id.description: Required only for `accept_offer`; partner and assets are read from this synchronized incoming offer.

body.description: `create_offer` requires an exact partner and asset sets. `accept_offer` requires only `account_id` and `target_trade_id`, and forbids customer-restated offer details. Customer price, credit, and profit calculations are intentionally not accepted by this execution-safety boundary.

tools.name: listV2TradeIntents
tools.description:
GET /v2/trade-intents
Returns saved trade instructions for the current workspace in newest-first order. A cursor can be reused only with the same filters. The response includes execution state and assets, but not customer prices, credits, or profit calculations.

tools.name: createV2TradeIntent
tools.description:
POST /v2/trade-intents
Creates a saved create_offer or accept_offer instruction after validating policy, inventory, and valuation. Outgoing assets are reserved in the same transaction.

kind.description: `create_offer` sends a customer-authored outbound offer. `accept_offer` binds an already synchronized incoming offer and does not accept customer-restated partner or asset fields.

external_reference.description: Your order, deposit, withdrawal, or ledger identifier. OpenSkin stores it but does not use it to make price or credit decisions.

target_trade_id.description: Required only for `accept_offer`. This is the workspace-owned synchronized incoming trade operation to bind.

expires_at.description: Customer-selected execution deadline from one minute to seven days after creation

body.description: For `create_offer`, `partner_steam_id64`, `offered`, and `requested` are required, at least one asset is required, and `target_trade_id` is forbidden. For `accept_offer`, `target_trade_id` is required and partner, message, offered, and requested must be omitted or empty. The customer owns the economic decision; OpenSkin validates and executes only the exact instruction or observed offer.

tools.name: getV2TradeIntent
tools.description:
GET /v2/trade-intents/{intent_id}
Returns one saved trade instruction owned by the current workspace.

tools.name: executeV2TradeIntent
tools.description:
POST /v2/trade-intents/{intent_id}/execute
Creates a Steam command from a reserved create_offer or accept_offer instruction after checking the synchronized offer state.

trade_offer_token.description: Optional only for `create_offer`. It is encrypted inside the execution command and never returned in the intent or execution response. It is rejected for `accept_offer`.

tools.name: cancelV2TradeIntent
tools.description:
POST /v2/trade-intents/{intent_id}/cancel
Releases all reserved outgoing assets. An instruction that is executing or active cannot be canceled here because it may already have been submitted to Steam. Repeating the request with the same Idempotency-Key and instruction returns the canceled instruction; using that key with another instruction returns a conflict.

tools.name: listV2Trades
tools.description:
GET /v2/trades
Returns synchronized and OpenSkin-created offers for the current workspace. Use external_offer_id to find an offer already recorded by OpenSkin. A cursor can be reused only with the same account and filters.

account_id.description: Restrict results to one workspace-owned managed account.

state.description: One state or a comma-separated set of lifecycle states.

external_offer_id.description: Restrict results to one Steam offer ID already recorded in this workspace.

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from the preceding response.

tools.name: getV2Trade
tools.description:
GET /v2/trades/{trade_id}
Returns one synchronized or OpenSkin-created Steam trade owned by the current workspace.

tools.name: reconcileV2Trade
tools.description:
POST /v2/trades/{trade_id}/reconcile
Queues a read-only IEconService/GetTradeOffer lookup for the trade's recorded Steam offer ID. OpenSkin updates only that offer and preserves newer recorded state. Reconciliation remains available when the account's safety switch pauses state-changing commands.

tools.name: cancelV2Trade
tools.description:
POST /v2/trades/{trade_id}/cancel
Queues cancellation of an outgoing Steam trade offer.

tools.name: declineV2Trade
tools.description:
POST /v2/trades/{trade_id}/decline
Queues rejection of an incoming Steam trade offer.

tools.name: listV2WebhookEventTypes
tools.description:
GET /v2/webhook-event-types
Lists the event types that can be sent to webhook endpoints.

tools.name: listV2Webhooks
tools.description:
GET /v2/webhooks
Returns webhook endpoints owned by the current workspace.

tools.name: createV2Webhook
tools.description:
POST /v2/webhooks
Creates a webhook endpoint and returns its signing secret with the initial response.

tools.name: updateV2Webhook
tools.description:
PUT /v2/webhooks/{endpoint_id}
Replaces the webhook endpoint URL and event subscriptions.

tools.name: disableV2Webhook
tools.description:
DELETE /v2/webhooks/{endpoint_id}
Disables the endpoint. Existing delivery history remains available.

tools.name: rotateV2WebhookSecret
tools.description:
POST /v2/webhooks/{endpoint_id}/rotate-secret
Returns the new secret once and keeps the prior version valid for existing deliveries for 24 hours.

tools.name: testV2Webhook
tools.description:
POST /v2/webhooks/{endpoint_id}/test
Queues a test event and delivery for the endpoint.

tools.name: listV2WebhookDeliveries
tools.description:
GET /v2/webhook-deliveries
Returns recent webhook deliveries in newest-first order.

tools.name: retryV2WebhookDelivery
tools.description:
POST /v2/webhook-deliveries/{delivery_id}/retry
Queues another delivery of a failed webhook event to its active endpoint.

tools.name: listV2Scenes
tools.description:
GET /v2/scenes
Returns viewer scenes owned by the current workspace.

tools.name: createV2Scene
tools.description:
POST /v2/scenes
Creates the first revision of a schema version 3 scene document. A scene contains presentation settings, not item identity or visual item state.

tools.name: getV2Scene
tools.description:
GET /v2/scenes/{scene_id}
Returns the latest revision of one viewer scene.

tools.name: updateV2Scene
tools.description:
PUT /v2/scenes/{scene_id}
Creates a new revision of the scene. Existing revisions remain unchanged.

If-Match.description: Quoted SHA-256 digest returned by the current scene ETag

tools.name: archiveV2Scene
tools.description:
DELETE /v2/scenes/{scene_id}
Archives the scene. Existing revisions remain available for render records and cannot be changed.

tools.name: createV2ViewerSession
tools.description:
POST /v2/viewer/sessions
Creates a temporary browser session for one catalog item and saved scene revision.

paint_index.description: Required only for weapon, knife, and gloves

tools.name: getV2ViewerPublication
tools.description:
GET /v2/viewer/publications/{publication_id}
Returns renderer publication status for the current workspace.

tools.name: createV2PublishedViewerSession
tools.description:
POST /v2/viewer/publications/{publication_id}/sessions
Creates a temporary session ticket after the item bundle has been published for the saved scene. The client cannot provide or choose a bundle ID.

tools.name: listV2ImageRenders
tools.description:
GET /v2/renders
Returns image requests for the current account in newest-first order.

tools.name: createV2ImageRender
tools.description:
POST /v2/renders
Creates an image using one catalog item, saved camera and background settings, and the requested output format. When it finishes, the image is available through a temporary private URL.

paint_index.description: Required only for weapon, knife, and gloves

background.description: Returns an alpha-bearing item cutout. The pinned scene supplies camera and lighting inputs, but its visible background is not included.

tools.name: getV2ImageRender
tools.description:
GET /v2/renders/{render_id}
Returns one image request. Completed requests include a private result URL valid for approximately five minutes.

tools.name: retryV2ImageRender
tools.description:
POST /v2/renders/{render_id}/retry
Retries a failed image request with the same item, saved settings, and output settings.
